name: Zac to Basics
source:
From the creator of "Zac's Day Out" comes the spin-off no one asked for, which one playtester described as "it makes Alice in Wonderland look sober". Follow along with the provided tutorial and learn how to create your own RenPy game!

Zac Jr has been a loyal partner to you ever since you were banished to the Choo, the dimension of highly marketable candy people. But when things get tense in your relationship and the gummy bear greaser isn't there to talk things through, how will you proceed?

[From [url=https://awildmartian.itch.io/zac-to-basics]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Zac's Day Out》的创作者推出了无人问津的衍生产品，一位游戏测试员称其为“它让爱丽丝梦游仙境看起来很清醒”。按照提供的教程学习如何创建你自己的RenPy游戏！

自从你被放逐到Choo（高销糖果人的维度）以来，小扎克（Zac Jr）就一直是你忠实的合作伙伴。但是，当你们的关系变得紧张，而小熊软糖润滑脂又无法解决问题时，你会如何处理呢？

[来自[url=https://awildmartian.itch.io/zac-to-basics]itch.io[/url]]
